ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: crossover_loss_combination_E1_repaired
ir.intuition: Preserves the original preference and sigmoid-based advantage penalty loss but replaces unsupported 'pow' operator with elementwise square using mul for stability and compatibility.
ir.pseudocode:
preference_loss = mean over pairs of [weight * (log_prob_l - log_prob_w)]
advantage_sigmoid = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
advantage_penalty = (advantage_sigmoid - advantage_gap)^2 computed as mul(diff, diff)
loss = preference_loss + mean(advantage_penalty)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    preference = ops.sub(log_prob_l, log_prob_w)
    pref_loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(weight, preference))
    p_w = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l))
    diff = ops.sub(p_w, advantage_gap)
    advantage_pen = ops.mul(diff, diff)  # square via mul instead of pow
    total_loss = ops.add(pref_loss, ops.mean(advantage_pen))
    return total_loss
